fields.description: The device's own address on the network. For push devices this is informational — the device reaches us, not the other way round.
fields.label: IP Address

fields.description: Port we dial to reach the device. Not used by ADMS/push devices — those send to the app's own port instead.
fields.label: Port

fields.description: PyZK = we ask the device for data. ADMS = the device sends data to us on its own. Pick ADMS for eSSL push devices.
fields.label: SDK Type

fields.description: ZK comm key, used only when dialling the device. Not used by ADMS/push devices.
fields.label: Communication Password (Comm Key)

fields.description: Leave off for normal ZK devices (TCP). Tick only when the device refuses TCP but answers UDP on the same port — some K300 units do this on 4370.
fields.label: Use UDP

fields.description: Set automatically. For push devices it reflects whether the device has been in touch recently, not whether it can be dialled.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: When this device last spoke to us. Written to the database rather than kept only in the cache, because clearing the cache would otherwise make a perfectly healthy device look as though it had never connected.
fields.label: Last Contact

fields.description: Clear this to park one machine without disabling the scheduler for all of them.
fields.label: Sync Enabled

fields.description: Watermark for attendance sync. Punches at or before this time are not re-read.
fields.label: Last Attendance Sync

fields.description: Watermark for user sync, tracked separately from attendance.
fields.label: Last User Sync

fields.description: Latest attendance upload marker echoed to the device as Stamp on ADMS handshake. Updated from each accepted ATTLOG POST.
fields.label: ADMS Attendance Stamp

fields.description: Latest user/operation upload marker echoed as OpStamp on ADMS handshake. Updated from each accepted OPERLOG/USERINFO POST.
fields.label: ADMS Operation Stamp

fields.description: How to encode punch-time stamps when the device sends placeholder Stamp=9999. Auto picks Unix vs ISO vs compact from the stored cursor; Unix matches the numeric examples in the HTTP PUSH SDK.
fields.label: ADMS Stamp Format
fields.options:
Auto
Unix Timestamp
ISO DateTime
Compact (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS)
